question: RAGTruth 语料大约包含多少个自然生成回答，人工标注覆盖哪两个粒度？
ground_truth: RAGTruth 包含接近 18,000 个自然生成回答，人工标注覆盖单个样本和词级两个粒度。
required_facts: manual annotations individual case and word levels
contexts: RAGTruth nearly 18,000 naturally generated responses; manual annotations individual case and word levels.

question: RAGTruth 的 Question Answering、Data-to-text Writing 和 News Summarization 分别使用什么数据源？
ground_truth: Question Answering 使用 MS MARCO，Data-to-text Writing 使用 Yelp Open Dataset，News Summarization使用 CNN/Daily Mail 以及近期新闻文章。
contexts: Question Answering MS MARCO; Data-to-text Writing Yelp Open Dataset; News Summarization CNN/Daily Mail.

question: RAGTruth 的每个回答由几名标注员独立标注，回答级和 span 级一致率是多少，分歧较大时如何处理？
ground_truth: 每个回答由两名标注员独立标注；回答级一致率为 91.8%，span 级为 78.8%；分歧较大时进行第三次复核。
required_facts: each response independently labeled by two annotators
contexts: Each response independently labeled by two annotators; 91.8% response level; 78.8% span level; third review.

question: RAGTruth Table 2 的 Overall 行中，instance 数、response 数和 hallucinated response 比例分别是多少？
ground_truth: Overall 行包含 2,965 个 instances、17,790 个 responses，hallucinated response 比例为 43.1%。
contexts: RAGTruth Table 2 Overall: Overall # Instance 2965; Overall # Resp. 17790; Overall 43.1%.

question: RAGTruth Table 5 中 Finetuned Llama-2-13B 的 Overall precision、recall 和 F1 分别是多少？
ground_truth: Overall precision 为 76.9，recall 为 80.7，F1 为 78.7。
contexts: RAGTruth Table 5 Finetuned Llama-2-13B: Overall precision 76.9, Overall recall 80.7, Overall F1 78.7. Finetuned Llama-2-13B 76.9; Finetuned Llama-2-13B 80.7; Finetuned Llama-2-13B 78.7.

question: RAGTruth 的 Limitations 提出后续还需要研究哪三个方向？
ground_truth: 需要检验检测模型跨数据集和上下文的泛化能力，比较人工标注与合成数据的效果，并探索将两者结合。
required_facts: generality capability across different datasets and contexts
contexts: Limitations: generality capability across different datasets and contexts; manual annotations versus synthetic data; combining both approaches.

question: MedExQA Table 1 中 Clinical Laboratory Science、Clinical Psychology 和 Speech Language Pathology 的问题数分别是多少？
ground_truth: 三个 specialty 的问题数分别为 377、111 和 135。
contexts: MedExQA Table 1: Clinical Laboratory Science NUM 377; Clinical Psychology NUM 111; Speech Language Pathology NUM 135.

question: MedExQA 总共有多少道题，few-shot development set 和 test set 如何划分？
ground_truth: 数据集共有 965 道题；few-shot development set 每个 specialty 5 道题，test set 共 940 道题。
required_facts: few-shot development set 5 questions per specialty
contexts: MedExQA total 965 questions; few-shot development set 5 questions per specialty; test set 940 questions.

question: MedExQA Table 3 中 Meditron Medical Guidelines 和 SNOMED CT descriptions 的预训练 token 数，以及 Asclepius Instruction 的指令数是多少？
ground_truth: 分别为 48.3M tokens、28.3M tokens 和 158,114 条 instructions。
contexts: MedExQA Table 3: Meditron Medical Guidelines Tokens 48.3M; SNOMED CT descriptions Tokens 28.3M; Asclepius Instruction 158,114.

question: MedPhi-2 训练使用了多少块 GPU，batch size、learning rate、epochs 和总训练时间分别是多少？
ground_truth: 训练使用 8 块 A6000 GPU，batch size 为 16，learning rate 为 1e-5，共 3 epochs，耗时 36 小时。
contexts: MedPhi-2 training: 8 A6000 GPUs; batch size 16; learning rate 1e-5; 3 epochs; 36 hours.

question: MedExQA Table 5 中 MedPhi-2 的模型规模、ROUGE-L、METEOR、BERTScore 和 AVG 分别是多少？
ground_truth: MedPhi-2 的规模为 2.7B，ROUGE-L 为 15.26，METEOR 为 17.75，BERTScore 为 37.45，AVG 为 19.15。
contexts: MedExQA Table 5 MedPhi-2: Size 2.7; ROUGE-L 15.26; METEOR 17.75; BERTScore 37.45; AVG 19.15.

question: MedExQA 的 Limitation 指出当前任务和人工评测有哪些边界，未来准备如何扩展？
ground_truth: 当前版本只测试 QA；人工评测每个 specialty 只有 5 个样本。未来计划增加带解释的临床笔记摘要任务，并增加样本量和标注员数量。
required_facts: current version only tests QA task
summarizing clinical notes with accompanying explanations
increase volume of samples and number of annotators
contexts: MedExQA limitation: current version only tests QA task; 5 samples per specialty; future work includes summarizing clinical notes with accompanying explanations and will increase volume of samples and number of annotators.

question: M-LongDoc 有多少样本，其文档和回答形式有什么特点，retrieval-aware tuning 将正确性提高了多少？
ground_truth: M-LongDoc 有 851 个样本，文档长达数百页，要求开放式解释；retrieval-aware tuning 将回答正确性相对提高 4.6%。
contexts: M-LongDoc 851 samples; documents spanning hundreds of pages; open-ended explanations; correctness 4.6%.

question: M-LongDoc 的 retrieval-aware tuning 训练语料规模多大，测试时使用多少检索页，训练上下文包含哪些页面？
ground_truth: 训练语料包含来自 300 份文档的 10,070 个样本；测试时使用 top-k=5 页面；训练上下文包含 ground-truth evidence page 以及可能无关的 distractor pages。
contexts: M-LongDoc training corpus 10,070 samples across 300 documents; top k = 5 pages; training uses the ground-truth evidence page and potentially irrelevant pages.

question: M-LongDoc 的自动正确性得分如何采样聚合？J 和 K 分别是多少，每次评分使用什么范围？
ground_truth: 系统使用 J=3 个 judge models，每个 judge 采样 K=5 个分数后聚合；每次给出 1 到 5 的 correctness score。
contexts: M-LongDoc score aggregation: J = 3 judge models; K = 5 sampled scores per judge; correctness score from 1 to 5.
